scope: Direct visual layout review of every assigned final PNG: all 16 Viola pages and changed Cello pages 9 and 15. This is not a fresh source-notation review.
method: Each original final output-review PNG was opened individually through view_image. Page-specific visual observations are recorded below. Manifest placement geometry supplements the visual review; no rendered pixels, source files, PDFs or production code were modified.

summary.residualConcern: Substantial retained neighboring-staff notes, slurs, beams and occasional text remain. Cello retains source publisher number 7892. This receipt does not claim clean part isolation.
summary.pageTurnLimit: System boundaries and visible navigation were reviewed. Continuous passages frequently cross page turns; no player timing or performance-readiness certification was performed.
summary.musicalCompletenessLimit: Final visible rows and final barlines were checked for layout containment. Exact retained notation for the seven trims is under the separate parent review; unassigned Cello pages were not re-viewed here.
